automation_evidence.quote: Decisions are derived from combining insights from these analyses, also considering the current financial position

metric_evidence.quote:
With comprehensive experiments on 6 financial datasets, including
stocks and Crypto, FinAgent significantly outperforms 12 stateof-the-art baselines in terms of 6 financial metrics with over 36%
average improvement on profit.

evidence.quote:
When comparing the ML and MLH, the addition of
the high-level reflection module significantly enhances the ARR%
and SR, while notably reducing risk.

practical_problems.note: component ablation of low- and high-level reflection (trade-outcome feedback) measured with return, Sharpe, drawdown and volatility; one stock shows a 7% rise in MDD

evidence.quote:
iv) Expert Guidance provided by financial experts as the auxiliary information, aiming to furnish a thorough and well-rounded
comprehension of market status.

practical_problems.note: news, charts and expert guidance are fused, but no ablation removes a modality; only diversified retrieval is ablated, on AAPL

summary: Automates multimodal market analysis, memory retrieval, dual-level reflection and tool-assisted buy/hold/sell decisions; it beats 9 to 12 baselines on return and Sharpe across six assets in a chronological test, and the ablation shows reflection lowers risk, though stock-specific tools hurt on crypto.
